# jQuery Terminal

Vendored copy of [jQuery Terminal](https://terminal.jcubic.pl) by
[Jakub T. Jankiewicz](https://jcubic.pl/me), released under the MIT license
(see `LICENSE`).

- Source: https://github.com/jcubic/jquery.terminal
- Version: 2.48.1 (git tag `2.48.1`)
- Files: `js/jquery.terminal.js` (unminified, so it can be edited),
  `js/jquery.mousewheel-min.js` and `css/jquery.terminal.css`, copied
  unchanged from that tag.

Local modifications to these files should be noted here.
